name: lane-code
title: LaneCode
summary: Lane identifier — renders as `LAX → SFO` with a proper arrow glyph (→ U+2192, not -> ascii) and mono-numerics. Optional inline rate (e.g. '$262'). Compact horizontal pill with hairline border. Use everywhere a freight lane is referenced.
description: Freight lane code with arrow + optional inline rate. Mono numerics.
skillDescription: Use anywhere a freight lane shows up — table cells, breadcrumbs, page titles, chart axes. Always use the U+2192 → glyph (not ASCII -> or →). Optional `rate` slot renders the price inline with a hairline separator. For animated arc rendering on a map, use @lumen/lane-arc.
never: NEVER use ASCII '->' for the arrow — use U+2192 ('→').
NEVER use Title Case for codes (always uppercase).
NEVER nest a LaneCode inside another LaneCode.
a11yRules: Renders the arrow as a real character (→) — screen readers read it naturally.
aria-label='Lane: {origin} to {destination}{', rate ' + rate}' for clarity.
do: Pair with rate in revenue contexts.
